en: The postcard displays a black and white photograph of a street lined with wooden buildings, likely barracks or institutional housing, with several men in uniform and civilian dress standing and walking in front. The architecture features two-story wooden structures with gabled roofs and many windows. Trees line both sides of the street, suggesting a well-planned area. The postcard has text at the top in Swedish.
